whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Ghar Aangan Restaurant,

I noticed your restaurant has over 1,200 reviews in the Veerchand Patel Road area, but lacked a dedicated mobile ordering and table reservation page.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, popular food menu, aur digital gallery integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/gharaangan

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Ghar Aangan Restaurant team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant (Ghar Aangan Restaurant, Veerchand Patel Road) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table booking, mobile-first menu display, and showcase of your high-volume local dining popularity. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact food items, actual restaurant photos aur online menu setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
